description: Race-level defaults for the Race Configuration view and the simulator.

targets.description: Nominal until the pre-race report runs. The simulator recalibrates both off the first flying lap.

fuel_policy.description: In-race refuelling has been banned in Formula 1 since 2010, and nothing in the schema carries a refuel event — a car starts with its whole race load. The simulator therefore sizes the starting load from the race distance rather than from a fixed number of kilograms, so that laps-of-fuel-remaining stays just above laps-left-to-run for the whole race instead of running hundreds of laps clear of it. fuel_margin_pct above is how much is carried over the race's own requirement, and is the only fuel lever the strategy has.
